description: Critique: diagnose a draft and report ranked findings without rewriting — the editorial letter. Use when a piece is finished, stuck, or 'something is off' and the user wants an honest review, feedback, a diagnosis of what's wrong, or to know what to fix first. Works for fiction and nonfiction. Read-only: no rewriting, no edits — revision is writing-revise, line fixes are writing-edit.
